'''Denis Henriquez''' ([[Oranjestad, Aruba|Oranjestad]], October 10, 1945) is an [[Aruba]]n writer.<ref>{{Cite web |url=http://www.uitgeverijmarmer.nl/boeken/literatuur/item/denis-henriquez |title=Denis Henriquez |access-date=2017-03-09 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20170312042602/http://www.uitgeverijmarmer.nl/boeken/literatuur/item/denis-henriquez |archive-date=2017-03-12 |url-status=dead }}</ref>

He studied physics in [[Delft]] and worked as a teacher  at the [[w:nl:Erasmiaans Gymnasium|Erasmiaans Gymnasium]] from [[Rotterdam]].

==Works==
*1981 ''E soño di Alicia.'' Based on "[[Alice's Adventures in Wonderland|Alice in Wonderland]]" by [[Lewis Carroll]] 
*1988 ''Kas pabow'' (poems)
*1992 ''Zuidstraat''
*1995 ''Delft blues''
*1999 ''De zomer van Alejandro Bulos''

==Prizes==
''Prijsvraag van het Antilliaans Verhaal'', 1990
